name: PT Pulau Subur Tbk
summary: PT Pulau Subur Tbk provides palm oil development services in Indonesia. It also engages in the plantation, livestock, agriculture, trading, forestry, fisheries, and services businesses. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Palembang, Indonesia. PT Pulau Subur Tbk is a subsidiary of PT. Sekawan Kontrindo.
